message.content: {"steps": [{"description": "MAIN MENU screen FW-00 for FERNWHISTLE VETERINARY GROUP is visible, showing 1 PATIENT LOOKUP, 2 BILLING BATCH, 3 VACCINATION REPORT, 4 DECOMMISSION, with COMMAND ===> blank and STATUS: READY. The cursor sits at the command field and nothing is typed.", "end_s": 6.0, "start_s": 0.0}, {"description": "Operator types '1' at COMMAND ===> on the MAIN MENU screen.", "end_s": 7.0, "start_s": 6.0}, {"description": "Screen changes to PATIENT LOOKUP FW-01 for MAPLE ST CLINIC. The PATIENT ID field shows WV-004812 with the cursor at the start of the field. Lower fields NAME, SPECIES, BREED, DOB, OWNER, PHONE, VACCINATIONS, ALLERGIES, BALANCE and LATE FEE are blank, and text reads 'RECORD FOUND. PF5 UPDATES, PF12 DECOMMISSIONS.'", "end_s": 8.0, "start_s": 7.0}, {"description": "Operator types / overwrites the PATIENT ID field character by character, cursor moving left to right across the field. The value changes through F, FW, FWV, FWV-, FWV-0, FWV-00, FWV-004, FWV-0048, FWV-00481 until it reads FWV-004812.", "end_s": 19.0, "start_s": 8.0}, {"description": "Operator submits the lookup and the screen changes to PATIENT SEARCH RESULTS FW-02, listing FW-004812 BELLA, FW-004811 MAX, FW-004810 LUNA, FW-004809 CHARLIE, FW-004808 COOPER, FW-004807 DAISY, FW-004806 ROCKY, FW-004805 MOLLY, FW-004804 DUKE, FW-004803 SADIE, with '12 MATCHES. PAGE DOWN SCROLLS, PF9 OPENS THE MENU.'", "end_s": 28.0, "start_s": 20.0}, {"description": "Operator presses Page Down on PATIENT SEARCH RESULTS. The list scrolls up one line: BELLA disappears from the top, the list now starts FW-004811 MAX and ends FW-004802 TEDDY.", "end_s": 32.0, "start_s": 28.0}, {"description": "Operator presses Page Down again on PATIENT SEARCH RESULTS. The list scrolls up another line: MAX disappears, the list now starts FW-004810 LUNA and ends FW-004801 BAILEY, still showing '12 MATCHES.'", "end_s": 40.2, "start_s": 32.0}, {"description": "Operator presses PF9 and a dark green ACTION MENU overlay opens over the PATIENT SEARCH RESULTS list, showing 'U UPDATE RECORD', 'D DECOMMISSION' and 'X EXIT MENU'. The footer changes to PF1 HELP, PF3 EXIT, PF9 UPDATE.", "end_s": 47.0, "start_s": 40.2}, {"description": "Operator selects D DECOMMISSION from the ACTION MENU. Screen changes to DECOMMISSION CLINIC FW-09 for MAPLE ST CLINIC, PATIENTS 4812, LAST EXPORT 49 PAGES, 4812 RECORDS, with 'WARNING: DECOMMISSION IS PERMANENT. TYPE CLINIC NAME TO CONFIRM:' blank, 'EXPORT MUST MATCH PATIENT COUNT BEFORE CONFIRMING.', STATUS: AWAITING CONFIRMATION and PF12 CONFIRM in the footer.", "end_s": 53.0, "start_s": 47.0}, {"description": "Operator types in the TYPE CLINIC NAME TO CONFIRM field on the DECOMMISSION CLINIC screen, entering 'MAPLE ST' character by character: M, MA, MAP, MAPL, MAPLE, MAPLE , MAPLE S, MAPLE ST, with the cursor advancing after each character. Recording ends while typing the confirmation name.", "end_s": 59.2, "start_s": 53.0}]}
